ko.title: 4명 사망, 드론 의심 1대: 레바논의 취약한 휴전을 시험하는 이스라엘 공습의 내막

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## 남레바논의 치명적인 공방

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: 이스라엘 군사 작전이 레바논 영토에서 이스라엘을 향해 발사된 드론에 대응하여 수행되었다고 이스라엘군이 밝힌 후, 레바논 보건부는 이스라엘의 공습으로 남레바논에서 4명이 사망했다고 보고했다.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: 이번 공습은 이스라엘과 헤즈볼라 간의 휴전 합의가 발효된 이후 가장 심각한 긴장 고조 상황 중 하나를 기록했으며, 국경을 따라 흐르는 현재의 평화가 얼마나 쉽게 흔들릴 수 있는지를 극명하게 보여준다.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: 이스라엘군은 자국 항공기가 남부에서 군사 인프라를 재건하려는 헤즈볼라의 노력과 연관된 시설 및 개인들을 목표로 삼았다고 밝혔으며, 이곳은 마지막 대규모 전투 이후 마련된 조건에 따라 이 그룹의 무장 주둔이 축소되어야 하는 지역이다.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: 레바논 당국은 이스라엘이 대응의 도화선으로 인용한 드론 발사를 독자적으로 확인하지 않았으며, 헤즈볼라는 해당 사건에 대한 세부적인 공식 입장을 발표하지 않았다.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## 휴전이 계속해서 균열을 일으키는 이유

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: 이스라엘과 헤즈볼라 간의 가장 격렬했던 갈등 단계를 종식시킨 휴전은 완전한 평화 협정은 결코 아니었다.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: 이것은 여름철 회담에서 재확인된 프레임워크를 중심으로 구축되었으며, 이스라엘이 레바논 내부에서 유지하던 진지에서 철수하는 동안 헤즈볼라의 전투원과 무기를 리타니강 북쪽으로 점진적으로 밀어내는 것을 의미했다.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: 감시는 레바논 군대, 유엔 평화유지군(UNIFIL), 그리고 미국과 프랑스를 포함한 국제 관찰단이 참여하는 메커니즘에 맡겨졌다.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: 실제로는 그러한 구조가 반복적으로 시험대에 올랐다.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: 이스라엘은 헤즈볼라가 무기를 재비축하거나 지휘 인프라를 복원하는 것을 막기 위한 목적이라고 주장하며 공습을 계속 감행했고, 이 그룹이 무장 해제 약속을 완전히 준수하지 않았다고 주장했다.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: 이에 대해 레바논 당국과 헤즈볼라는 인구 밀집 지역 근처와 군사적 가치가 없다고 주장하는 인프라에 대한 타격을 포함하여 협소한 대테러 목적을 넘어선 공습을 통해 이스라엘이 휴전을 위반했다고 비난했다.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: 양측은 동일한 사건들을 다르게 해석한다. 이스라엘은 자국의 공습을 협정의 필수적인 집행으로 규정하는 반면, 레바논 당국은 그중 다수를 레바논 주권 침해로 묘사한다.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: 어느 단일 사건이라기보다는 이러한 해석의 간격이 분석가들이 지적하는 휴전의 핵심 취약점이다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은 무엇인가

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: 남레바논 주민들에게 현실적인 영향은 일상적 불확실성으로의 복귀이다.

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: 휴전 이후 피난민 가족들의 귀환을 보기 시작했던 마을들은 다시 한번 공습 소음과 드론 발사 의혹 같은 단일의 논란이 되는 사건이 더 광범위한 교전으로 이어질 수 있는 위험과 씨름하고 있다.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: 프레임워크 유지에 관여한 외교관들(중재를 도운 미국

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: 및 프랑스 관료들 포함)은 즉각적인 공습이나 보복 공격에 의존하기보다는 사건을 보고하고 검증하기 위해 합의된 채널을 고수하도록 양측을 압박할 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: 그러한 압박이 유지되는지에 따라 이번 최신 에피소드가 고립된 충돌로 남을지 아니면 광범위한 휴전이 무너지기 시작하는 순간이 될지가 결정될 수 있다.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 레바논 당국이 냉정을 촉구하고 공습 이전에 실제로 일어난 일에 대한 독립적인 조사를 촉구한 반면, 이스라엘 당국은 자신들의 조치가 직접적인 위협에 대한 비례적인 대응이었다고 주장하고 있다.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: 양국 정부 모두 휴전 유지를 원한다고 계속해서 확인하는 가운데, 다가오는 며칠은 그 공동의 이해관계가 또 다른 충격을 흡수할 만큼 충분히 강한지 보여줄 것이다.

zh.title: 四人死亡，一架疑似无人机：考验黎巴嫩脆弱停火的以色列空袭内幕

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## 黎巴嫩南部的一次致命交火

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: 据黎巴嫩卫生部报道，以色列在黎巴嫩南部发动的空袭造成四人死亡。此前，以色列军方表示，此次行动是对一枚从黎巴嫩领土向以色列发射的无人机的回应。

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: 这次空袭是以色列与真主党达成停火协议以来最严重的升级之一，它们凸显了目前脆弱的边境平静是多么容易被打破。

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: 以色列军方表示，其战机瞄准了他们所描述的地点和个人，这些目标与真主党在南部重建军事基础设施的努力有关。根据上一轮大战结束后达成的条款，真主党在这一地区的武装存在本应受到限制。

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: 黎巴嫩当局尚未独立证实以色列作为其回应导火索的无人机发射事件，真主党也没有对该事件发表详细的公开说明。

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## 为什么停火不断破裂

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: 结束以色列与真主党冲突最激烈阶段的停火从来都不是一项全面的和平协议。

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: 它是围绕一个框架构建的，并在夏季的会谈中得到再次确认，旨在逐步将真主党的武装人员和武器推至利塔尼河以北，同时以色列撤出其在黎巴嫩境内占领的阵地。

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: 监督工作交由一个涉及黎巴嫩军队、联合国维和部队（联黎部队）以及包括美国和法国在内的国际观察员的机制负责。

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: 在实践中，这一结构一再受到考验。

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: 以色列继续实施其所称旨在防止真主党补充武器或恢复指挥基础设施的空袭，并辩称该组织未能完全履行解除武装的承诺。

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: 作为回应，黎巴嫩官员和真主党指责以色列通过超越狭隘反恐目标的空袭违反了停火协议，其中包括对人口稠密地区附近以及他们称没有军事价值的基础设施的打击。

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: 双方对同一系列事件的解读不同：以色列将其实施的空袭描述为对协议的必要执行，而黎巴嫩官员则将其中许多描述为对黎巴嫩主权的侵犯。

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: 这种解释上的差距，而不是任何单一事件，正是分析人士指出停火的核心脆弱性所在。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: 对于黎巴嫩南部的居民来说，实际影响是回到了日常的不确定性中。

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: 自停火以来开始看到流离失所家庭返回的村庄再次陷入空袭的声响中，并面临着单一有争议的事件（如疑似无人机发射）可能引发更广泛交火的风险。

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: 参与维护该框架的外交官，包括帮助促成该协议的美国

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: 和法国官员，预计将敦促双方坚持商定的报告和核实事件渠道，而不是立即诉诸空袭或报复性攻击。

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: 这种压力能否维持可能决定这最新的一集是仍然是一个孤立的摩擦，还是成为更广泛的停火开始瓦解的时刻。

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: 目前，黎巴嫩官员呼吁保持冷静，并敦促在空袭发生前对实际发生的事情进行独立审查，而以色列官员则坚称他们的行动是对直接威胁的成比例回应。

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: 随着两国政府继续确认他们希望停火得以维持，接下来的几天可能会表明这种共同的利益是否强大到足以承受另一次冲击。

hi.title: चार मृत, एक कथित ड्रोन: लेबनान के नाजुक संघर्षविराम की परीक्षा ले रहे इजरायली हमलों के भीतर

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## दक्षिण लेबनान में एक घातक आदान-प्रदान

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: इजरायली हवाई हमलों में दक्षिणी लेबनान में चार लोग मारे गए, देश के स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने यह जानकारी दी। इजरायली सेना के यह कहने के बाद कि यह अभियान लेबनान के क्षेत्र से इजरायल की ओर लॉन्च किए गए एक ड्रोन के जवाब में चलाया गया था।

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: ये हमले इजरायल और हिजबुल्लाह के बीच संघर्षविराम समझौता लागू होने के बाद से सबसे गंभीर तनावपूर्ण स्थितियों में से एक हैं, और वे रेखांकित करते हैं कि सीमा पर मौजूदा शांति कितनी आसानी से डगमगा सकती है।

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: इजरायली सेना ने कहा कि उसके विमानों ने उन स्थलों और व्यक्तियों को निशाना बनाया जिन्हें उसने दक्षिण में सैन्य बुनियादी ढाचे को फिर से बनाने के हिजबुल्लाह के प्रयासों से जुड़ा बताया, जो कि एक ऐसा क्षेत्र है जहां पिछली बड़ी लड़ाई के बाद तय की गई शर्तों के तहत समूह की सशस्त्र उपस्थिति को सीमित किया जाना चाहिए था।

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: लेबनान के अधिकारियों ने स्वतंत्र रूप से उस ड्रोन लॉन्च की पुष्टि नहीं की है जिसका इजरायल ने अपनी प्रतिक्रिया के उत्प्रेरक के रूप में हवाला दिया है, और हिजबुल्लाह ने इस घटना का कोई विस्तृत सार्वजनिक विवरण जारी नहीं किया है।

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## संघर्षविराम क्यों बार-बार दरक रहा है

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: जिस संघर्षविराम ने इजरायल-हिजबुल्लाह संघर्ष के सबसे तीव्र चरण को समाप्त किया, वह कभी भी एक पूर्ण शांति समझौता नहीं था।

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: इसे एक रूपरेखा के आसपास बनाया गया था, जिसकी गर्मियों की बैठकों में पुष्टि की गई थी, जिसका उद्देश्य हिजबुल्लाह के लड़ाकों और हथियारों को धीरे-धीरे लिटानी नदी के उत्तर में धकेलना था, जबकि इजरायल लेबनान के भीतर अपने कब्जे वाले ठिकानों से पीछे हट रहा था।

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.

es.title: Cuatro muertos, un presunto dron: Dentro de los ataques israelíes que ponen a prueba la frágil tregua del Líbano

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## Un intercambio mortal en el sur del Líbano

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: Ataques aéreos israelíes mataron a cuatro personas en el sur del Líbano, informó el ministerio de salud del país, después de que el ejército israelí dijera que la operación se llevó a cabo en respuesta a un dron lanzado desde territorio libanés hacia Israel.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: Los ataques marcan una de las escaladas más graves desde que entró en vigor un acuerdo de alto el fuego entre Israel y Hezbolá, y subrayan lo fácil que se puede tambalear la actual calma a lo largo de la frontera.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: El ejército israelí dijo que sus aeronaves apuntaron a lo que describió como sitios e individuos vinculados a los esfuerzos de Hezbolá por reconstruir la infraestructura militar en el sur, un área donde se supone que la presencia armada del grupo debe ser reducida bajo los términos acordados tras la última ronda importante de combates.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: Las autoridades libanesas no han confirmado de forma independiente el lanzamiento del dron que Israel citó como el detonante de su respuesta, y Hezbolá no ha emitido un informe público detallado sobre el incidente.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## Por qué la tregua sigue agrietándose

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: El alto el fuego que puso fin a la fase más intensa del conflicto entre Israel y Hezbolá nunca fue un acuerdo de paz completo.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: Se construyó en torno a un marco, reafirmado en conversaciones durante el verano, destinado a empujar gradualmente a los combatientes y armas de Hezbolá al norte del río Litani mientras Israel se retiraba de las posiciones que había mantenido dentro del Líbano.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: La supervisión se dejó a un mecanismo que involucra al ejército libanés, a las fuerzas de paz de las Naciones Unidas (UNIFIL) y a observadores internacionales, incluidos Estados Unidos y Francia.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: En la práctica, esa estructura ha sido puesta a prueba repetidamente.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: Israel ha seguido llevando a cabo ataques que, según dice, tienen como objetivo evitar que Hezbolá reabastezca de armas o restaure la infraestructura de comando, argumentando que el grupo no ha cumplido plenamente con los compromisos de desarme.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios libaneses y Hezbolá, a su vez, han acusado a Israel de violar la tregua mediante ataques que van más allá de los estrechos objetivos antiterroristas, incluidos impactos cerca de áreas pobladas y sobre infraestructura que, según dicen, no tiene valor militar.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Cada bando interpreta el mismo conjunto de eventos de manera diferente: Israel enmarca sus ataques como una aplicación necesaria del acuerdo, mientras que los funcionarios libaneses describen muchos de ellos como violaciones de la soberanía libanesa.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: Esa brecha en la interpretación, más que cualquier incidente aislado, es lo que los analistas señalan como la vulnerabilidad central de la tregua.

segments.tr: وما إذا كان هذا الضغط سيصمد قد يحدد ما إذا كانت هذه الحلقة الأخيرة ستظل مجرد توتر معزول أم ستصبح اللحظة التي تبدأ فيها الهدنة الأوسع في الانهيار.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، دعا المسؤولون اللبنانيون إلى الهدوء وحثوا على إجراء مراجعة مستقلة لما حدث بالفعل قبل الضربات، بينما يؤكد المسؤولون الإسرائيليون أن تحركهم كان رداً متناسباً على تهديد مباشر.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.

fr.title: Quatre morts, un drone présumé : au cœur des frappes israéliennes qui mettent à l'épreuve la fragile trêve au Liban

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## Un échange meurtrier dans le sud du Liban

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: Des frappes aériennes israéliennes ont tué quatre personnes dans le sud du Liban, a rapporté le ministère de la Santé du pays, après que l'armée israélienne a déclaré que l'opération avait été menée en réponse à un drone lancé depuis le territoire libanais vers Israël.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: Ces frappes marquent l'une des escalades les plus sérieuses depuis la mise en place d'un accord de cessez-le-feu entre Israël et le Hezbollah, et elles soulignent à quel point le calme actuel le long de la frontière peut être facilement ébranlé.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: L'armée israélienne a déclaré que ses avions avaient ciblé ce qu'elle a décrit comme des sites et des individus liés aux efforts du Hezbollah pour reconstruire son infrastructure militaire dans le sud, une zone où la présence armée du groupe est censée être limitée selon les termes établis après la dernière grande phase de combats.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: Les autorités libanaises n'ont pas confirmé de manière indépendante le lancement du drone qu'Israël a cité comme déclencheur de sa réponse, et le Hezbollah n'a pas publié de compte rendu public détaillé de l'incident.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la trêve continue de se fissurer

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: Le cessez-le-feu qui a mis fin à la phase la plus intense du conflit entre Israël et le Hezbollah n'a jamais été un accord de paix complet.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: Il a été construit autour d'un cadre, réaffirmé lors de pourparlers au cours de l'été, visant à repousser progressivement les combattants et les armes du Hezbollah au nord du fleuve Litani tandis qu'Israël se retirait des positions qu'il occupait à l'intérieur du Liban.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: La surveillance a été confiée à un mécanisme impliquant l'armée libanaise, les forces de maintien de la paix des Nations unies (FINUL) et des observateurs internationaux, notamment les États-Unis et la France.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: En pratique, cette structure a été testée à plusieurs reprises.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: Israël a continué de mener des frappes qu'il dit viser à empêcher le Hezbollah de réapprovisionner ses armes ou de restaurer son infrastructure de commandement, arguant que le groupe ne s'est pas pleinement conformé aux engagements de désarmement.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: Les responsables libanais et le Hezbollah, à leur tour, ont accusé Israël de violer la trêve par des frappes qui vont au-delà d'objectifs étroits de lutte contre le terrorisme, y compris des tirs près de zones peuplées et sur des infrastructures qui, selon eux, n'ont aucune valeur militaire.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Chaque camp interprète la même série d'événements différemment : Israël présente ses frappes comme une application nécessaire de l'accord, tandis que les responsables libanais décrivent nombre d'entre elles comme des violations de la souveraineté libanaise.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: Ce fossé dans l'interprétation, plutôt que tout incident isolé, est ce que les analystes désignent comme la vulnérabilité fondamentale de la trêve.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: Pour les habitants du sud du Liban, l'effet pratique est un retour à l'incertitude quotidienne.

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: Les villages qui avaient commencé à voir les familles déplacées revenir depuis le cessez-le-feu sont à nouveau aux prises avec le bruit des frappes aériennes et le risque qu'un seul incident contesté, comme un lancement de drone présumé, puisse déclencher un échange plus large.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: Les diplomates impliqués dans le maintien du cadre, y compris les responsables américains

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: et français qui ont aidé à le négocier, devraient faire pression sur les deux parties pour qu'elles s'en tiennent aux canaux convenus pour signaler et vérifier les incidents plutôt que de recourir immédiatement à des frappes ou à des attaques de représailles.

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: La capacité de cette pression à perdurer pourrait déterminer si ce dernier épisode reste une flambée isolée ou devient le moment où la trêve plus large commence à se défaire.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les responsables libanais ont appelé au calme et exhorté à un examen indépendant de ce qui s'est réellement passé avant les frappes, tandis que les responsables israéliens maintiennent que leur action était une réponse proportionnée à une menace directe.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: Alors que les deux gouvernements continuent d'affirmer qu'ils souhaitent que le cessez-le-feu tienne, les jours à venir montreront probablement si cet intérêt commun est assez fort pour absorber un nouveau choc.

segments.tr: ## Por que a trégua continua se rompendo

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: O monitoramento foi deixado para um mecanismo envolvendo o exército libanês, as forças de paz das Nações Unidas (UNIFIL) e observadores internacionais, incluindo os Estados Unidos e a França.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: Na prática, essa estrutura foi testada repetidamente.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Cada lado interpreta o mesmo conjunto de eventos de maneira diferente: Israel enquadra seus ataques como uma aplicação necessária do acordo, enquanto as autoridades libanesas descrevem muitos deles como violações da soberania libanesa.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.

segments.tr: Por enquanto, as autoridades libanesas pediram calma e solicitaram uma revisão independente do que realmente aconteceu antes dos ataques, enquanto as autoridades israelenses mantêm que sua ação foi uma resposta proporcional a uma ameaça direta.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.

in.title: Empat Tewas, Satu Dugaan Drone: Di Balik Serangan Israel yang Menguji Gencatan Senjata Rapuh Lebanon

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## Pertukaran Mematikan di Lebanon Selatan

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: Serangan udara Israel menewaskan empat orang di Lebanon selatan, lapor kementerian kesehatan negara tersebut, setelah militer Israel mengatakan operasi tersebut dilakukan sebagai tanggapan atas drone yang diluncurkan dari wilayah Lebanon menuju Israel.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: Serangan-serangan ini menandai salah satu eskalasi yang lebih serius sejak perjanjian gencatan senjata antara Israel dan Hizbullah berlaku, dan menegaskan betapa mudahnya ketenangan saat ini di sepanjang perbatasan dapat terguncang.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: Militer Israel mengatakan pesawatnya menargetkan apa yang disebutnya sebagai situs dan individu yang terkait dengan upaya Hizbullah untuk membangun kembali infrastruktur militer di selatan, sebuah area di mana kehadiran bersenjata kelompok tersebut seharusnya dikurangi berdasarkan ketentuan yang dirumuskan setelah putaran pertempuran besar terakhir.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: Otoritas Lebanon belum mengonfirmasi secara independen peluncuran drone yang dikutip Israel sebagai pemicu tanggapannya, dan Hizbullah belum mengeluarkan penjelasan publik yang rinci mengenai insiden tersebut.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Gencatan Senjata Terus Retak

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: Gencatan senjata yang mengakhiri fase paling intens dari konflik Israel-Hizbullah tidak pernah menjadi perjanjian damai penuh.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: Gencatan senjata itu dibangun di sekitar kerangka kerja, yang ditegaskan kembali dalam pembicaraan selama musim panas, yang dimaksudkan untuk secara bertahap mendorong para pejuang dan senjata Hizbullah ke utara Sungai Litani sementara Israel mundur dari posisi yang dipegangnya di dalam Lebanon.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: Pemantauan diserahkan kepada mekanisme yang melibatkan tentara Lebanon, pasukan penjaga perdamaian Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa (UNIFIL), dan pengamat internasional, termasuk Amerika Serikat dan Prancis.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, struktur tersebut telah diuji berkali-kali.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: Israel terus melancarkan serangan yang dikatakannya bertujuan untuk mencegah Hizbullah mengisi kembali persediaan senjata atau memulihkan infrastruktur komando, dengan alasan bahwa kelompok tersebut belum sepenuhnya mematuhi komitmen pelucutan senjata.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: Pejabat Lebanon dan Hizbullah, pada gilirannya, menuduh Israel melanggar gencatan senjata melalui serangan yang melampaui tujuan kontraterorisme yang sempit, termasuk serangan di dekat daerah berpenduduk dan pada infrastruktur yang mereka katakan tidak memiliki nilai militer.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Masing-masing pihak menafsirkan rangkaian peristiwa yang sama secara berbeda: Israel membingkai serangannya sebagai penegakan hukum yang diperlukan dari kesepakatan tersebut, sementara pejabat Lebanon menggambarkan banyak dari serangan tersebut sebagai pelanggaran terhadap kedaulatan Lebanon.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan interpretasi itulah, alih-alih insiden tunggal apa pun, yang ditunjukkan oleh para analis sebagai kerentanan inti dari gencatan senjata tersebut.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: Bagi warga Lebanon selatan, efek praktisnya adalah kembalinya ketidakpastian sehari-hari.

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: Desa-desa yang mulai melihat keluarga pengungsi kembali sejak gencatan senjata kini kembali bergulat dengan suara serangan udara dan risiko bahwa satu insiden yang dipersengketakan, seperti dugaan peluncuran drone, dapat memicu pertukaran yang lebih luas.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: Para diplomat yang terlibat dalam mempertahankan kerangka kerja tersebut, termasuk pejabat AS

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: dan Prancis yang membantu memediasinya, diharapkan untuk mendesak kedua belah pihak agar tetap berpegang pada saluran yang disepakati untuk melaporkan dan memverifikasi insiden daripada langsung beralih ke serangan atau serangan balasan.

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: Apakah tekanan itu bertahan dapat menentukan apakah episode terbaru ini tetap menjadi gejolak yang terisolasi atau menjadi momen di mana gencatan senjata yang lebih luas mulai runtuh.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, para pejabat Lebanon telah menyerukan ketenangan dan mendesak tinjauan independen mengenai apa yang sebenarnya terjadi sebelum serangan tersebut, sementara pejabat Israel bersikeras bahwa tindakan mereka adalah respons yang proporsional terhadap ancaman langsung.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: Dengan kedua pemerintahan yang terus menegaskan bahwa mereka ingin gencatan senjata tetap bertahan, hari-hari mendatang kemungkinan akan menunjukkan apakah kepentingan bersama tersebut cukup kuat untuk menyerap kejutan lain.

segments.tr: レバノン当局は、イスラエルが対応の引き金として挙げたドローンの発射を独自に確認しておらず、ヒズボラもこの事件に関する詳細な公式説明を発表していない。

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## なぜ停戦は崩れ続けるのか

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: イスラエルとヒズボラの紛争の最も激しい段階を終わらせた停戦は、完全な和平合意では決してなかった。

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: それは、夏に行われた協議で再確認された枠組みに基づいて構築されたもので、イスラエルがレバノン国内で保持していた陣地から撤退する一方で、ヒズボラの戦闘員と武器をリタニ川の北へ徐々に押し戻すことを意図していた。

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: 監視は、レバノン軍、国連平和維持軍（UNIFIL）、および米国やフランスを含む国際監視団が関与するメカニズムに委ねられた。

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: 実際には、その構造は繰り返し試されてきた。

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: イスラエルは、ヒズボラが武器を補充したり指揮インフラを回復したりするのを防ぐことを目的としていると主張し、空爆を続けている。同国は、ヒズボラが武装解除の公約を完全には遵守していないと主張している。

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: 一方、レバノンの当局者やヒズボラは、イスラエルが限定的な対テロ目的を超えた空爆を行い、人口密集地域付近や軍事的価値がないと彼らが主張するインフラへの攻撃を含め、停戦に違反していると非難している。

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: 双方は同じ一連の出来事を異なって解釈している。イスラエルは自らの空爆を合意の必要な執行であると位置づける一方、レバノンの当局者はその多くをレバノンの主権侵害であると説明している。

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: 単一の事件ではなく、この解釈のギャップこそが、アナリストが指摘する停戦の核心的な脆弱性である。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: 南レバノンの住民にとって、実際の影響は日常的な不確実性への回帰である。

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: 停戦以来、避難していた家族が戻り始めていた村々は、再び空爆の音と、ドローン発射疑惑のような単一の論争的な事件が、より広範な交戦を引き起こすリスクに直面している。

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: この枠組みの維持に関与している外交官たち（米国を含む）

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: および仲介を支援したフランスの当局者は、直ちに空爆や報復攻撃に訴えるのではなく、事件の報告と検証のために合意されたチャネルを維持するよう双方に強く働きかけると予想される。

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: その圧力が維持されるかどうかが、今回の最新の出来事が孤立した小競り合いにとどまるか、それともより広範な停戦が崩壊し始める瞬間となるかを決定する可能性がある。

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: 今のところ、レバノンの当局者は冷静さを呼びかけ、空爆の前に実際に何が起こったのかについて独立した調査を行うよう促している一方、イスラエルの当局者は、彼らの行動は直接的な脅威に対する均衡のとれた対応であったと主張している。

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: 両政府とも停戦を維持したいという意向を表明し続けているため、この共通の利益が別の衝撃を吸収するのに十分な強さを持っているかどうかは、今後数日で明らかになるだろう。

de.title: Vier Tote, eine mutmaßliche Drohne: Einblicke in die israelischen Angriffe, die den fragilen Waffenstillstand im Libanon auf die Probe stellen

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## Ein tödlicher Schlagabtausch im Südlibanon

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: Bei israelischen Luftangriffen im Südlibanon sind vier Menschen ums Leben gekommen, wie das Gesundheitsministerium des Landes mitteilte. Das israelische Militär erklärte, der Einsatz sei eine Reaktion auf eine von libanesischem Gebiet aus in Richtung Israel gestartete Drohne gewesen.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: Die Angriffe markieren eine der schwerwiegenderen Eskalationen seit Inkrafttreten der Waffenstillstandsvereinbarung zwischen Israel und der Hisbollah und unterstreichen, wie leicht die derzeitige Ruhe entlang der Grenze erschüttert werden kann.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: Das israelische Militär teilte mit, seine Flugzeuge hätten Ziele und Personen angegriffen, die mit den Bemühungen der Hisbollah zur Wiederherstellung der militärischen Infrastruktur im Süden in Verbindung stünden – einem Gebiet, in dem die bewaffnete Präsenz der Gruppe gemäß den nach der letzten großen Kampfrunde ausgehandelten Bedingungen eigentlich eingeschränkt sein sollte.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: Die libanesischen Behörden haben den Drohnenstart, den Israel als Auslöser für seine Reaktion anführte, nicht unabhängig bestätigt, und die Hisbollah hat keine detaillierte öffentliche Darstellung des Vorfalls veröffentlicht.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## Warum der Waffenstillstand immer wieder bröckelt

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: Der Waffenstillstand, der die intensivste Phase des Konflikts zwischen Israel und der Hisbollah beendete, war nie ein vollständiges Friedensabkommen.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: Er basierte auf einem Rahmenwerk, das im Laufe des Sommers in Gesprächen bekräftigt wurde und darauf abzielte, die Kämpfer und Waffen der Hisbollah schrittweise nördlich des Litani-Flusses zurückzudrängen, während Israel sich aus Stellungen zurückzog, die es innerhalb des Libanon gehalten hatte.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: Die Überwachung wurde einem Mechanismus überlassen, an dem die libanesische Armee, die UN-Friedenstruppen (UNIFIL) und internationale Beobachter, darunter die Vereinigten Staaten und Frankreich, beteiligt sind.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: In der Praxis wurde diese Struktur wiederholt auf die Probe gestellt.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: Israel führt weiterhin Angriffe durch, die nach eigenen Angaben darauf abzielen, die Hisbollah daran zu hindern, Waffen aufzustocken oder die Führungsinfrastruktur wiederherzustellen, mit dem Argument, dass die Gruppe die Abrüstungsverpflichtungen nicht vollständig erfüllt habe.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: Libanesische Beamte und die Hisbollah wiederum werfen Israel vor, den Waffenstillstand durch Angriffe zu verletzen, die über enge Anti-Terror-Ziele hinausgehen, einschließlich Treffern in der Nähe von bewohnten Gebieten und auf Infrastruktur, die ihrer Meinung nach keinen militärischen Wert hat.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Jede Seite interpretiert dieselben Ereignisse unterschiedlich: Israel stellt seine Angriffe als notwendige Durchsetzung des Abkommens dar, während libanesische Beamte viele davon als Verletzung der libanesischen Souveränität beschreiben.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: Diese Diskrepanz in der Interpretation, und nicht ein einzelner Vorfall, ist das, was Analysten als die zentrale Schwachstelle des Waffenstillstands bezeichnen.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: Für die Bewohner des Südlibanon bedeutet dies in der Praxis eine Rückkehr zur täglichen Ungewissheit.

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: Dörfer, in denen seit dem Waffenstillstand wieder vertriebene Familien zurückgekehrt waren, kämpfen erneut mit dem Geräusch von Luftangriffen und dem Risiko, dass ein einziger umstrittener Vorfall, wie ein mutmaßlicher Drohnenstart, einen breiteren Schlagabtausch auslösen kann.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.
segments.tr: Diplomaten, die an der Aufrechterhaltung des Rahmenwerks beteiligt sind, darunter US-amerikanische

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: und französische Beamte, die bei der Vermittlung geholfen haben, werden voraussichtlich beide Seiten dazu drängen, sich an die vereinbarten Kanäle zur Meldung und Überprüfung von Vorfällen zu halten, anstatt sofort zu Angriffen oder Vergeltungsmaßnahmen zu greifen.

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: Ob dieser Druck standhält, könnte darüber entscheiden, ob dieser jüngste Vorfall ein isoliertes Aufflammen bleibt oder der Moment wird, in dem der umfassendere Waffenstillstand zu bröckeln beginnt.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: Derzeit haben libanesische Beamte zur Ruhe aufgerufen und eine unabhängige Untersuchung der tatsächlichen Geschehnisse vor den Angriffen gefordert, während israelische Beamte darauf beharren, dass ihr Vorgehen eine verhältnismäßige Reaktion auf eine direkte Bedrohung gewesen sei.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: Da beide Regierungen weiterhin bekräftigen, dass der Waffenstillstand halten soll, werden die kommenden Tage wahrscheinlich zeigen, ob dieses gemeinsame Interesse stark genug ist, um einen weiteren Schock zu verkraften.

vi.title: Bốn người thiệt mạng, một máy bay không người lái bị cáo buộc: Bên trong các cuộc không kích của Israel đang thử thách lệnh ngừng bắn mong manh của Lebanon

segments.src: ## A Deadly Exchange in South Lebanon
segments.tr: ## Một cuộc trao đổi đẫm máu ở miền Nam Lebanon

segments.src: Israeli airstrikes killed four people in southern Lebanon, the country's health ministry reported, after the Israeli military said the operation was carried out in response to a drone launched from Lebanese territory toward Israel.
segments.tr: Các cuộc không kích của Israel đã giết chết bốn người ở miền nam Lebanon, theo báo cáo của bộ y tế nước này, sau khi quân đội Israel cho biết chiến dịch được thực hiện để đáp trả một máy bay không người lái được phóng từ lãnh thổ Lebanon về phía Israel.

segments.src: The strikes mark one of the more serious escalations since a ceasefire arrangement between Israel and Hezbollah took hold, and they underscore how easily the current calm along the border can be shaken.
segments.tr: Các cuộc tấn công đánh dấu một trong những sự leo thang nghiêm trọng hơn kể từ khi thỏa thuận ngừng bắn giữa Israel và Hezbollah có hiệu lực, và chúng nhấn mạnh sự bình yên hiện tại dọc biên giới có thể bị lung lay dễ dàng như thế nào.

segments.src: The Israeli military said its aircraft targeted what it described as sites and individuals linked to Hezbollah's efforts to rebuild military infrastructure in the south, an area where the group's armed presence is supposed to be curtailed under the terms worked out after the last major round of fighting.
segments.tr: Quân đội Israel cho biết máy bay của họ đã nhắm mục tiêu vào những gì họ mô tả là các địa điểm và cá nhân liên quan đến nỗ lực của Hezbollah nhằm xây dựng lại cơ sở hạ tầng quân sự ở miền nam, một khu vực mà sự hiện diện vũ trang của nhóm này được cho là phải bị hạn chế theo các điều khoản đã được thống nhất sau vòng giao tranh lớn cuối cùng.

segments.src: Lebanese authorities have not independently confirmed the drone launch that Israel cited as the trigger for its response, and Hezbollah has not issued a detailed public accounting of the incident.
segments.tr: Các nhà chức trách Lebanon chưa xác nhận độc lập về vụ phóng máy bay không người lái mà Israel viện dẫn là nguyên nhân cho phản ứng của họ, và Hezbollah cũng chưa đưa ra lời giải trình công khai chi tiết về vụ việc.

segments.src: ## Why the Truce Keeps Cracking
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lệnh ngừng bắn liên tục bị rạn nứt

segments.src: The ceasefire that ended the most intense phase of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict was never a full peace agreement.
segments.tr: Lệnh ngừng bắn chấm dứt giai đoạn căng thẳng nhất của cuộc xung đột Israel-Hezbollah chưa bao giờ là một thỏa thuận hòa bình toàn diện.

segments.src: It was built around a framework, reaffirmed in talks over the summer, meant to gradually push Hezbollah's fighters and weapons north of the Litani River while Israel withdrew from positions it had held inside Lebanon.
segments.tr: Nó được xây dựng dựa trên một khuôn khổ, được tái khẳng định trong các cuộc đàm phán vào mùa hè, nhằm dần dần đẩy các chiến binh và vũ khí của Hezbollah về phía bắc sông Litani trong khi Israel rút khỏi các vị trí mà họ đã chiếm giữ bên trong Lebanon.

segments.src: Monitoring was left to a mechanism involving the Lebanese army, United Nations peacekeepers (UNIFIL), and international observers, including the United States and France.
segments.tr: Việc giám sát được giao cho một cơ chế bao gồm quân đội Lebanon, lực lượng gìn giữ hòa bình của Liên Hợp Quốc (UNIFIL) và các quan sát viên quốc tế, bao gồm Hoa Kỳ và Pháp.

segments.src: In practice, that structure has been tested repeatedly.
segments.tr: Trên thực tế, cấu trúc đó đã bị thử thách nhiều lần.

segments.src: Israel has continued carrying out strikes it says are aimed at preventing Hezbollah from restocking weapons or restoring command infrastructure, arguing that the group has not fully complied with disarmament commitments.
segments.tr: Israel đã tiếp tục thực hiện các cuộc tấn công mà họ cho là nhằm ngăn chặn Hezbollah tích trữ vũ khí hoặc khôi phục cơ sở hạ tầng chỉ huy, với lập luận rằng nhóm này chưa tuân thủ đầy đủ các cam kết giải giáp vũ khí.

segments.src: Lebanese officials and Hezbollah, in turn, have accused Israel of violating the truce through strikes that go beyond narrow counterterrorism aims, including hits near populated areas and on infrastructure they say has no military value.
segments.tr: Các quan chức Lebanon và Hezbollah, ngược lại, đã cáo buộc Israel vi phạm lệnh ngừng bắn thông qua các cuộc tấn công vượt ra ngoài các mục tiêu chống khủng bố hẹp, bao gồm các cuộc tấn công gần các khu vực đông dân cư và vào cơ sở hạ tầng mà họ cho là không có giá trị quân sự.

segments.src: Each side interprets the same set of events differently: Israel frames its strikes as necessary enforcement of the deal, while Lebanese officials describe many of them as violations of Lebanese sovereignty.
segments.tr: Mỗi bên diễn giải cùng một chuỗi sự kiện theo cách khác nhau: Israel coi các cuộc tấn công của mình là việc thực thi cần thiết thỏa thuận, trong khi các quan chức Lebanon mô tả nhiều cuộc tấn công trong số đó là vi phạm chủ quyền của Lebanon.

segments.src: That gap in interpretation, rather than any single incident, is what analysts point to as the truce's core vulnerability.
segments.tr: Khoảng cách trong cách diễn giải đó, thay vì bất kỳ sự cố đơn lẻ nào, là điều mà các nhà phân tích chỉ ra là lỗ hổng cốt lõi của lệnh ngừng bắn.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: For residents of southern Lebanon, the practical effect is a return to daily uncertainty.
segments.tr: Đối với cư dân miền nam Lebanon, tác động thực tế là sự trở lại của sự bất ổn hàng ngày.

segments.src: Villages that had begun to see displaced families return since the ceasefire are once again grappling with the sound of airstrikes and the risk that a single contested incident, like an alleged drone launch, can trigger a broader exchange.
segments.tr: Những ngôi làng đã bắt đầu thấy các gia đình di tản trở về kể từ khi lệnh ngừng bắn có hiệu lực lại một lần nữa phải vật lộn với âm thanh của các cuộc không kích và nguy cơ rằng một sự cố tranh chấp đơn lẻ, như một vụ phóng máy bay không người lái bị cáo buộc, có thể kích hoạt một cuộc trao đổi rộng hơn.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in sustaining the framework, including U.S.

segments.src: and French officials who helped broker it, are expected to press both sides to stick to the agreed channels for reporting and verifying incidents rather than resorting immediately to strikes or retaliatory attacks.
segments.tr: và Pháp, những người đã giúp làm trung gian cho nó, dự kiến sẽ gây áp lực buộc cả hai bên phải tuân thủ các kênh đã thỏa thuận để báo cáo và xác minh các sự cố thay vì ngay lập tức dùng đến các cuộc tấn công hoặc các cuộc trả đũa.

segments.src: Whether that pressure holds may determine if this latest episode remains an isolated flare-up or becomes the moment the broader truce starts to unravel.
segments.tr: Liệu áp lực đó có giữ vững hay không có thể quyết định liệu tập mới nhất này vẫn là một sự bùng phát cô lập hay trở thành thời điểm lệnh ngừng bắn rộng hơn bắt đầu tan rã.

segments.src: For now, Lebanese officials have called for calm and urged an independent review of what actually happened before the strikes, while Israeli officials maintain their action was a proportionate response to a direct threat.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, các quan chức Lebanon đã kêu gọi bình tĩnh và thúc giục một cuộc đánh giá độc lập về những gì thực sự đã xảy ra trước các cuộc tấn công, trong khi các quan chức Israel duy trì rằng hành động của họ là một phản ứng tương xứng đối với một mối đe dọa trực tiếp.

segments.src: With both governments continuing to affirm they want the ceasefire to hold, the coming days are likely to show whether that shared interest is strong enough to absorb another shock.
segments.tr: Với việc cả hai chính phủ tiếp tục khẳng định họ muốn lệnh ngừng bắn được duy trì, những ngày tới có khả năng sẽ cho thấy liệu lợi ích chung đó có đủ mạnh để hấp thụ một cú sốc khác hay không.
